facts.fact: Bethany 带 Aries 身体进 Short Stack gym；emergency protocol 启动、警报响
facts.anchor: Public Access Afterworld’s emergency protocol has been activated.

facts.fact: locker room 走廊变迷宫、lockers 像 ancient cemetery 的 grand tombs
facts.anchor: now resembling a row of grand tombs in an ancient cemetery

facts.fact: 她找到退化的 Lil' Angus（atrophied/ventriloquist's dummy）；他摊开手心是沙漏（hourglass）
facts.anchor: like a ventriloquist’s dummy left out for years in the sun

facts.fact: 看到沙漏她 blood thin；瞬间变成 David Sawyer 无力的 patient body
facts.anchor: For a moment, she becomes David Sawyer, naked and powerless

facts.fact: 追捕者 Coach Horton 连续变形：Fisch→Jim→Marty→Elliot→无眼 cowboy（ant holes）
facts.anchor: He never stops changing. He keeps degrading back down through the generations

facts.fact: 最后一形无名，她只想到 The Distant Seer
两人躲 locker、追捕者嘲笑『I know my star player is in here』
facts.anchor: I know my star player is in here somewhere!

facts.fact: 她用 Orpheus 典故命令 don't look back、冲出崩塌的 gym
外面变 swimming（mudslides/quicksand）、Lil' Angus 被 vortex 吞、她 dive after（要大团圆结局证明非 victim）
facts.anchor: That she isn’t just another victim.

facts.fact: gateway 后不是另一部剧而是 burning red static/crimson tower（destroyer of worlds）
facts.anchor: The future of television. The destroyer of worlds.

facts.fact: 她自疑 unleashing fire burn universe、crimson 蔓延吞 Short Stack
facts.anchor: That she will be the future of television, the destroyer of worlds.

facts.fact: Lil' Angus 突然年轻 spark returns（It's why I called to you）
facts.anchor: This is why I called to you

facts.fact: 她觉得红色 beautiful、Maybe we should let it burn；交棒 wake up/get high/break glass
facts.anchor: I’m going to try to break the glass and release the airwaves.

facts.fact: 尾句 I'll see you soon / one more scene to finish
facts.anchor: I’ve just got one more scene to finish.
